title: The injective quotient complex computes puncture cohomology
statement: Let R be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], W the open complement of its closed point in Spec R [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and I any injective resolution of R as an R-module. For every natural number n, H^n(W,O_W), defined as Modules.H of the unit structure module, is additively equivalent to H^n(coker(Gamma_m(I) into I)), where the inclusion is [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-cocomplex-inclusion] and Gamma_m is [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-functor].

proof.text: A prime containing m equals m, so the specified W equals Spec R minus V(m). The associated sheaves of the injective modules I^k are flasque on the Noetherian affine scheme by 09T2, and their restrictions to W are flasque. Sheafification and restriction are exact (on affine basic opens this is exactness of localization), so these sheaves form a resolution of O_W.

For finite generators f_i of m, the kernel of I^k into sections on W is exactly Gamma_m(I^k): vanishing in each localization gives exponents e_i killing the element by f_i^e_i; a power with exponent sum e_i kills it by the pigeonhole principle for monomials. The converse follows by localization. Flasqueness gives surjectivity. These maps commute with the differentials, so the sections complex is the cokernel of the explicit torsion inclusion.

The flasque acyclic-resolution computation identifies all cohomology groups of the sections complex with Ext from the constant integer sheaf to the additive structure sheaf. This is Modules.H of the unit module. For an empty W both the sections complex and its cohomology vanish, and the same comparison applies. No connecting isomorphism and no derived torsion comparison is used here.

theorem nonempty_punctured_h_addEquiv_injective_quotient
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (W : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
    (hW : ∀ x : Spec (.of R), x ∈ W ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint R)
    (I : InjectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of R R : ModuleCat.{u} R)) (n : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (Modules.H (X := W.toScheme)
      (SheafOfModules.unit W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) n ≃+
      ((cokernel (ModuleCat.idealPowerTorsionCocomplexι
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) I.cocomplex)).homology n).carrier)
